findings.title: Eight mobile medical units, including six maternity clinics and one dialysis clinic, reportedly still await entry to Gaza near Cairo
findings.publisher: UOL (reporting The Independent's investigation and quoting aid groups and COGAT)
findings.location: Near Cairo, Egypt; intended deployment in Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Planned maternity, newborn, dialysis and general medical care for Gaza patients; eight mobile medical units not yet delivering service
findings.summary: UOL reported, citing The Independent, that eight mobile medical units (six maternity units, one dialysis clinic and one general-care unit) remained near Cairo pending permission to enter Gaza, with some waiting up to two years. Aid groups Palestine Aid UK and Medics Worldwide alleged Israeli restrictions/dual-use classifications were responsible. Israel's COGAT disputed the allegation, stated other mobile clinics had entered Gaza and three additional clinics had recently been approved, and said qualifying formal requests for these eight would be assessed. No approval, shipment, arrival, or new obstruction event during the current hourly interval was independently verified.

findings.source_type: Established news outlet summarizing another established outlet's reporting, with named humanitarian-group claims and Israeli authority response; original not directly retrieved
